title: Never leaving New Orleans, and offers elsewhere
summary: Hug stayed in New Orleans despite offers from Venuti and out-of-town clubs.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: How far away did you get away from your city?
Well, you know, dick me, I've never been out of New Orleans in my life. I don't live over 150 miles and all through the war I was only 60 miles. That's about as far as I ever got.
That's fun. Do you have an office to play with big bands away from here?

Yeah, I had quite a bit of office. One time I had an offer from Joe Venuti when he was in town here. And, of course, I had several individual offerings out of town at different clubs that hang over in San Francisco. They wanted me out there a couple of times. Joe Delaney wanted to vote for me in New York just recently. But I never could make up my mind. In fact, not that I could make up my mind, circumstances just wouldn't let me go. So here I am still in New Orleans.
